C1359.title: Venus Protocol Suffers 7th Flash Loan Attack
C1359.summary: In March 2026, the Thena (THE) market hosted on Venus Protocol (BNB Chain) was exploited. The attacker accumulated THE tokens over nine months to control about 84% of the supply cap, then deployed a malicious contract exploiting a donation flaw in the Venus smart contracts and the getCashPrior balance-reading design to inflate THE's exchange rate by 3.81x, pushing its price from $0.263 to over $0.51, repeatedly borrowing and donating THE back to amplify borrowing power. The resulting liquidation cascade left the protocol with about $2.18 million in bad debt.
